title: Green Rewards Card: Setting Sustainability Goals for Your Business
summary: Explains how to set sustainability goals for a Green Rewards Card using two frameworks: offset-based goals (CO₂ offsets at $0.06 per dollar of spend) and tree-based goals (tree planting tied to a $3,000 spend threshold). Covers translating targets into spend, tracking via a dashboard, adjusting category strategies, and an execution checklist (configure category mappings, review/fine-tune goals, share progress).
faqs: How do I choose between offset-based and tree-based sustainability goals for the Green Rewards Card?
What conversion factor ($0.06 per dollar) do I use to translate an offset CO₂ target into required card spend?
What spend threshold ($3,000) do I use to translate a tree-planting goal into a spend target?
Where do I track goal progress and what should I do when I’m off target?
What steps are in the execution checklist (category mappings, reviews/refinement, stakeholder updates)?
